Description: The shop smells of parchment, ink, and a faint trace of spiced wine.
Shelves are stacked with trinkets and relics, some useful, others merely collecting dust.
The merchant flips through his ledger, eyes sharp enough to spot a missing coin from across the hall.
Clay pots and crates line the floor, promising both treasure and disappointment within.
Old banners hang above, their faded colors a reminder of festivals long past.
In this place, knowledge and bargains are traded as fiercely as swords on the battlefield.
